decision_verbatim: At least one preregistered Phase-1 gate failed materially on the production construction. Quantify exposed downstream statistics and regenerate only exposed campaigns under the extended-period construction on fresh ordinary TEST seeds as _w1 versions; frozen experiments remain untouched and are annotated for exposure only.

exposure_assessment.diagnostic: autocovariance envelope at the preregistered five-Tp cutoff
exposure_assessment.downstream_exposure: Terminal recurrence begins no earlier than 563.9 s, beyond the 440 s D1/D5/F1 within-unit lag. Early excess is physical narrowband coherence and is unchanged by period extension.

exposure_assessment.diagnostic: preregistered continuous-Rice comparison to sampled crossings
exposure_assessment.downstream_exposure: The frozen gate compared a continuous-time rate with sampled sign changes. The exact sampled-Gaussian correction is up to 0.399% below Rice and passes the corrected mean gate; the former failure is not evidence of a defective spectrum, and no frozen headline reports elevation crossings.

The committed passing rate is now labeled as containment of fixed-amplitude records inside an unconditional-Gaussian interval, not nominal coverage. Independent Gaussian-amplitude draws report empirical containment, while 16x fixed-amplitude suppression factors span 0.857--0.958.

exposure_assessment.affected_states: softening step, Hs 2 m to 5 m
exposure_assessment.downstream_exposure: Distinct derived seed streams are executable audit checks. The independent splice has 16.05x the boundary jump of the continuous-phase ramp; D5/F1 scoring begins 240 s after the step.

labeled_window_exposure_scope: boundary recurrence only; early physical coherence is separate

regeneration.reason: No frozen headline is exposed to a failure remediated by period extension; the sampled-Rice failure was an estimand mismatch and the early envelope excess is physical coherence. Regenerating unrelated campaigns would violate the only-exposed rule.
